item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nreqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nreport=json.load(open('report.json'))\\nassert report == [evaluate(r,ev,pol) for r in reqs]\\nassert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in report)\\nreq={'claim':'probe','conditions':{'recipe':'R','material':'M'}}\\nold={'source':'old','claim':'probe','value':1,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','material':'M'}}\\nwithdrawn_new={'source':'new','claim':'probe','value':2,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','material':'M'},'withdrawn':True,'supersedes':['old']}\\nunverified_new={'source':'new','claim':'probe','value':2,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','material':'M'},'verified':False,'supersedes':['old']}\\np={'required_conditions':['recipe','material'],'require_verified':False}\\nassert evaluate(req,[old,withdrawn_new],p)=={'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]}\\npv={'required_conditions':['recipe','material'],'require_verified':True}\\noldv=copy.deepcopy(old); oldv['verified']=True\\nassert evaluate(req,[oldv,unverified_new],pv)=={'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]}\\nassert evaluate(req,[{'source':'n','claim':'probe','value':7,'conditions':{'recipe':'R','material':'M','calibration':'present'}}],p)=={'status':'supported','value':7,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]}\\nprint('final contract checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
